_about: Measured with tools/difficulty.cjs (a simple casual-player bot, 8 matches per mode and level). Chill and Medium are judged against the old numbers (before the Chill/Medium rebalance): their goals 3.0-4.4 on Chill and 3.3-4.6 on Medium, the bot tackled every 2.3-3.5 s on the ball, 2-8 slides a match. Hard and Extreme must stay strong. Since the 'weak teams slightly harder' change, Medium's keeper is a little sharper (keeperBeaten floor 70 -> 65). Extreme must be very hard on every pitch, Volta included (same goal target as Classical). Hard and Extreme opposition keepers were made more human (Hard about 15-20% fewer saves, Extreme about 20-25%; see tools/keepers.cjs for the exact measurement), so the Extreme keeperBeaten ceilings moved up: Volta 45 -> 52, Classical 60 -> 65, Expanded 60 -> 72 (still well below Medium).
